recommendedBy: session agent, before the branch reaches main

items.why: Merging is what publishes, and it is also the moment three pinned installs start reading the wrong documentation.
The index this package tells an agent to read first is the one file an install cannot reach.
Three applications cannot move until the upgrade is packaged and the version is real; a draft exists outside the repository.
What blocked is fixed; what is left is one capture nobody has reproduced since, so it waits.
